import re
import sys

def main():
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    output_stream = sys.stdout
    in_data = input_stream.read().splitlines()
    n = int(in_data[0])
    input_str = in_data[1]
    pattern = r"\([\w_]*\)"
    outSite = re.split(pattern, input_str)
    longest = max((longestWords(s) for s in outSite), default=0)
    matches = re.findall(pattern, input_str)
    numberInside = 0
    for match in matches:
        inner = match[1:-1]  # trim parentheses
        parts = inner.split('_')
        numberInside += sum(1 for s in parts if s)
    print(f"{longest} {numberInside}")

def longestWords(line):
    return max((len(s) for s in line.split('_')), default=0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
